items.headline: Baseball crowns its best arms — and MVP drops tonight
items.body: It's awards week. The Cy Youngs are in: Milwaukee flamethrower Jacob Misiorowski took the NL after leading the majors with a sparkling 1.80 ERA, and Yankees rookie Cam Schlittler ran away with the AL — a unanimous pick, all 30 first-place votes. MVP winners get revealed tonight.
items.say: Baseball's handing out its big awards this week — a rookie just won the AL Cy Young unanimously, and MVP comes out tonight. You keep up with baseball at all?

items.headline: The Beard's still cooking — Harden drops 32 as Cavs down the Knicks
items.body: James Harden rolled back the years with 32 points and five threes as Cleveland handled New York 115-107. Not bad for a guy deep into his late 30s — Harden is quietly having a terrific season.
items.say: Did you see James Harden drop 32 on the Knicks? The man's still going strong this deep into his career — kind of wild he's this good.

items.headline: Lightning light up Buffalo in an 8-3 rout
items.body: Tampa Bay poured it on in Buffalo, rolling to an 8-3 win — the kind of lopsided night that reminds you the Lightning can absolutely fill a net. Eight goals on the road is a statement.
items.say: The Lightning hung EIGHT goals on Buffalo last night. You follow any hockey? The NHL quietly puts on a show.

items.headline: USMNT back in action Saturday — Nations League knockout vs Haiti
items.body: The U.S. men open their Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal Saturday against Haiti, though the 'home' leg was moved to Miami. Win the two-legged tie — the second leg's in Cincinnati on Nov 17 — and they book a spot in next March's Nations League finals.
items.say: The USMNT's back Saturday — a Nations League knockout against Haiti down in Miami. You catching any of the national team these days?

links.text: USMNT vs Haiti preview (CBS Sports Golazo)

items.headline: Brad Pitt is back as Cliff Booth — with Tarantino and Fincher
items.body: The trailer's here for 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth' — Brad Pitt reprising his Oscar-winning stuntman from 'Once Upon a Time in Hollywood,' with Quentin Tarantino writing and David Fincher directing. It hits IMAX on Nov 25 before streaming on Netflix.
items.say: Did you see the trailer where Brad Pitt's playing Cliff Booth again? Tarantino wrote it and Fincher's directing — that's a ridiculous combo of talent.

items.headline: '12 12 12' — Anthony Mackie vs Jamie Dornan in a Zurich heist
items.body: Apple TV's new heist thriller '12 12 12' drops Friday — Anthony Mackie as a disgraced FBI agent chasing Jamie Dornan's slick criminal around a massive bank-vault job in Zurich. Each episode unspools three timelines: 12 months to plan, 12 hours to pull it off, 12 days to get away.
items.say: There's a new heist show on Apple TV called 12 12 12 — Anthony Mackie versus Jamie Dornan, big Zurich bank job. Clever hook. You into a good heist?

items.headline: Tyla kicks off her first-ever world tour tonight
items.body: Grammy-winning South African star Tyla launches the North American leg of her first headline world tour tonight near Sacramento. If you know 'Water,' you know the vibe — slinky, sun-soaked pop built for dancing.
items.say: Tyla — the 'Water' singer — kicks off her first world tour tonight. Such a fun, danceable sound. You heard that song? It was everywhere.

items.headline: Amy Poehler & Hugh Laurie's new comedy 'Dig' is coming
items.body: From Mike Schur — the brain behind 'Parks and Rec' and 'The Good Place' — comes 'Dig,' a Peacock comedy starring Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie. All 10 episodes drop November 23, right in time for a cozy holiday-week binge.
items.say: Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie have a new comedy coming from the Parks and Rec creator — perfect Thanksgiving-week binge. You have a go-to comfort show?
